prerequisites.en: Basic mathematics, material and energy balance, and fundamental chemical engineering concepts such as unit operations and process flow diagrams; familiarity with equipment such as reactors, pumps, boilers, distillation columns and heat exchangers, and basic financial concepts (official prerequisite, GTU syllabus DI05005021)
prerequisites.gu: પાયાનું ગણિત, material અને energy balance, અને unit operations તથા process flow diagrams જેવા મૂળભૂત chemical engineering ખ્યાલો; reactors, pumps, boilers, distillation columns અને heat exchangers જેવા સાધનોની ઓળખ, અને પાયાના નાણાકીય ખ્યાલો (સત્તાવાર prerequisite, GTU syllabus DI05005021)

topics: 1.5 Design and selection of chemical engineering equipment

title.en: Development of project for plant and process design
title.gu: પ્લાન્ટ અને પ્રોસેસ ડિઝાઇન માટે પ્રોજેક્ટનો વિકાસ

topics: 2.2 Process evolution stages and their importance
2.3 Plant design factors: 2.3.1 Technical factors, 2.3.2 Economic factors, 2.3.3 Legal factors, 2.3.4 Safety and sanitation
3.3 Selection of process equipment and specification sheet for equipment
3.5 Selection of equipment: (a) Size reduction equipment, (b) Heat transfer equipment, (c) Material handling equipment, (d) Mass transfer equipment, (e) Pumps
3.6 Piping, Pipe strength and wall thickness
3.8 Types of insulation, Factors governing selection of insulation
4.3 Factors for selection of plant location: Primary factors and specific factors
5.4 Factors affecting investment and production costs
5.5 Cost Indices, Cost-Size relation, and cost-Time relation
5.8 Methods for determining depreciation: Arbitrary methods, Methods with interest on investment
5.10 Profitability analysis: Net and gross earnings
5.11 Percent return on investment, Pay-out time period, Present worth, Turn-over ratio

course_outcomes.en: CO1: Gain basic knowledge of chemical engineering plant and process design in industries (RBT: R, U)
course_outcomes.gu: CO1: ઉદ્યોગોમાં chemical engineering plant અને process design નું પાયાનું જ્ઞાન મેળવો (RBT: R, U)

course_outcomes.en: CO2: Understand a process to start new project by considering the concept of plant and process design (RBT: R, U)
course_outcomes.gu: CO2: Plant અને process design ના ખ્યાલને ધ્યાનમાં રાખી નવો project શરૂ કરવાની process સમજો (RBT: R, U)

course_outcomes.en: CO3: Select process equipment or instruments of the same function based on both technical and commercial point of view (RBT: U, A)
course_outcomes.gu: CO3: સમાન કાર્યના process equipment કે instruments ની technical અને commercial બંને દૃષ્ટિએ પસંદગી કરો (RBT: U, A)

course_outcomes.en: CO4: Choose appropriate plant location and plant layout for the chemical project (RBT: U, A)
course_outcomes.gu: CO4: Chemical project માટે યોગ્ય plant location અને plant layout પસંદ કરો (RBT: U, A)

course_outcomes.en: CO5: Apply knowledge of economics for project to run an industry with profitability (RBT: R, U, A)
course_outcomes.gu: CO5: Project માટે economics નું જ્ઞાન લાગુ કરી ઉદ્યોગને નફાકારક રીતે ચલાવો (RBT: R, U, A)

source_note: Official GTU syllabus DI05005021 (w.e.f. 2026-27), 6 pages, uploaded by the owner; text copy in tools/syllabus_DI05005021.txt.
source_discrepancies: The official scheme is theory-only (L3 T1 PR0; ESE 70 + PA 30 = 100 marks, 4 credits); the 12 suggested tutorials are carried as guided practice inside Units 2, 3 and 5.

Unit 3 is printed 'Selection of chemical engineering equipments' and 3.1 'selection of material' (material of construction); contents recorded as printed, taught as material-of-construction selection.
Unit 5 lists both '5.6 Numerical based on Cost Indices' and '5.14 Numerical of Break-even analysis' (sic); recorded as printed.
